from PIL import Image
img=Image.open('/mnt/data/source(4).jpg')
print(img.size)

import numpy as np, PIL
a=np.array(img)
# nonwhite threshold any channel < 245
mask=(a[:,:,:3]<245).any(axis=2)
row_counts=mask.sum(axis=1)
# print ranges rows with >500 pixels
ranges=[]
inr=False
for i,c in enumerate(row_counts):
    if c>500 and not inr: s=i; inr=True
    if inr and (c<=500 or i==len(row_counts)-1):
        e=i-1; ranges.append((s,e,row_counts[s:e+1].max())); inr=False
ranges[:20], len(ranges)

from scipy.ndimage import label, find_objects
# non-white threshold more strict
m=(a[:,:,:3]<250).any(axis=2)
lab,n=label(m)
objs=find_objects(lab)
comps=[]
for k,sl in enumerate(objs,1):
    if sl:
        area=(lab[sl]==k).sum()
        if area>10000:
            ysl,xsl=sl
            comps.append((area,xsl.start,ysl.start,xsl.stop-1,ysl.stop-1))
sorted(comps, reverse=True)[:20]
